TRON TRC20 tokens only. Per-token GasFree settings, an object with: `enabled` (boolean, default `false`) — must be `true` to opt this token into gasless transfers; and `transfer_max_fee` (numeric string, optional) — caps the total token-denominated GasFree fee (the transfer fee plus, on the account's first transfer, the one-time activation fee) you will allow, in token units. Requires the platform coin to be activated with a [TronGaslessProviderConfig](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/activation/#tron-gasless-provider-config). See [TRON GasFree transfers](/komodo-defi-framework/tutorials/tron-gasfree/).

Base URL of the GasFree provider. For the public GasFree API (`gas_free` service), use a host-only `https` URL e.g. `https://open.gasfree.io` (mainnet) or `https://open-test.gasfree.io` (Nile/Shasta testnets) — the network path segment (`/tron/`, `/nile/`, `/shasta/`) is appended automatically, and non-`https` schemes are rejected at activation since requests to the provider carry API credentials. For the `komodo_proxy` service, the full proxy URL is used as-is (`http` or `https`).

Selects the gasless auth rail. Either an object `{ "gas_free": { "api_key": "...", "api_secret": "..." } }` to authenticate directly to the GasFree API with HMAC-SHA256 credentials, or the string `"komodo_proxy"` to route requests through the Komodo proxy (the proxy holds the GasFree credentials and the node authenticates with its libp2p key, so no API secret is stored locally).

Optional. TRON address (`T...`) of the GasFree service provider to pin for the TIP-712 `PermitTransferMessage`. When omitted, the provider is fetched automatically from the GasFree API (`/api/v1/config/provider/all`) on the first gasless operation (account status, withdraw, or submit) after activation, the first returned provider is used, and the resolved address is cached for the life of the activation. A configured address is kept when present in the fetched list; if the list is fetched successfully but does not include the configured address, that first gasless operation fails with `ProviderIdentityMismatch` — activation itself does not fetch or validate the provider list. If fetching the provider list fails and `service_provider` was configured, the framework logs a warning and uses the configured address.
Optional. Request timeout in milliseconds for GasFree API calls.
Optional. Polling interval in milliseconds for transfer status checks (used by [stream::gasless_trace::enable](/komodo-defi-framework/api/v20/streaming/gasless_trace_enable/)).
Mamimum UTXO count before merge loop is initiated.
How frequently (in blocks) the wallet UTXO count is evaluated.

The maximum nouber of UTXOs to inlude as inputs for a merge transaction. Note that more input UTXOs means a larger transaction and greater fees, and that each blockchain has a limit to the maximum size of a transaction.
